facts.business: Responsive Industries Limited is engaged in the sale of goods, with revenue recognized upon transfer of control to customers through dispatch, delivery, or formal acceptance.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to inappropriate assessment of transfer of control, particularly for domestic sales throughout the year and export sales recorded at period end
facts.related_party_note: The Company is in compliance with Section 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 with respect to applicable transactions with related parties, and details have been disclosed in the Standalone Financial Statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
